rules.source: Ordonnance-loi n° 23/010 du 13 mars 2023 portant Code du numérique (Titre III, protection des données) — https://law.ungovr.org/ai/cd
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary: the Code sets out the DRC's first detailed personal-data regime (lawfulness, transparency, security) and provides for a data protection authority (APD); APD functions reportedly given temporarily to ARPTIC by ministerial decree of 17 August 2024; authority not fully operational and subject of legal challenge.
